Owned idle Switch/New where retirement stays pending: raises SESSION_IDLE_EXIT_UNCONFIRMED_PENDING_48 and retains the slot; no product-side Stop/force UI.
Absolute shutdown-deadline handoff to a retained #41 helper; only direct workers were exercised here.
Extension-created descendant/subagent cleanup (#48/#61): not attested; no PID-tree kill or blanket descendant claim.
Windows Chrome/WSL2 browser matrix, scale/performance targets, and native TUI complement reruns.
limits: SIGKILL cannot run Host cooperative cleanup; restart evidence proves durable index/credential survival and manual reopen with fresh native ownership checks, not signal-time cleanup.
The synthetic fixture uses the isolated candidate CLI with no provider dispatch; results do not attest any real user Session or global OMP installation.
Browser evidence ran headless Linux Chromium via CHROME_EXECUTABLE/shim resolution; no Windows-browser acceptance is implied.
